Welspun Corp Secures ₹4,000 Crore US Pipe Order

Welspun Corp's US-based arm has secured an order worth ₹4,000 crore for High-Frequency Induction Welded (HFIW) pipes from a US facility. The company's stock saw gains following the announcement of this record order.
